interpretation: The absence of a full Pionex multi-year universe does not invalidate Binance as the primary learning source.
Binance-native evidence must not be relabeled as Pionex-native evidence.
Pionex-native calibration and execution-domain validation are required project milestones because Pionex is the intended trading venue.
Candidate selection or observability is not equivalent to materialized Pionex historical K-line coverage.
